final: WITH rental_totals AS (SELECT i.store_id, r.rental_id, SUM(p.amount) AS payment_total FROM payment AS p JOIN rental AS r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.store_id, r.rental_id), store_averages AS (SELECT store_id, AVG(payment_total) AS average_total FROM rental_totals GROUP BY store_id) SELECT rt.store_id, SUM(rt.payment_total) AS combined_payment_total, AVG(rt.payment_total - sa.average_total) AS average_amount_above_average FROM rental_totals AS rt JOIN store_averages AS sa ON sa.store_id = rt.store_id WHERE rt.payment_total > sa.average_total GROUP BY rt.store_id ORDER BY rt.store_id
